briefing.text: Nvidia's board brought Jensen Huang back as CEO, and its shares rose about 30%.
GTA VI sold an estimated 44.9 million copies in four days, analysts say.
OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6.2 Sol to paid ChatGPT users.
The Hunger Games prequel heads into Thanksgiving after a $225 million global opening.
Some unclassified CIA and US intelligence data was breached, reports say.

stories.title: Nvidia's board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, and the shares jump about 30%
stories.summary: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on November 23 to bring back Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, days after his resignation.
stories.why: Nvidia is the most important supplier of AI chips, so who runs it moves markets and politics.
stories.happened: Nvidia confirmed the reinstatement. Reuters reported Trump and Vance intervened, and Bloomberg said the shares rose 31%. The Senate Banking Committee set a December 3 hearing with Huang as sole witness.
stories.next: Watch for the December 3 Senate hearing and the board's ongoing independent investigation.

drivers.label: U-turn
drivers.text: The board had ruled out his return only days earlier.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Reports put the one-day share gain near 30%, its biggest since 2003.

drivers.label: Politics
drivers.text: Lawmakers from both parties have criticised the decision.

stories.background: Jensen Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and ran it for over three decades as it became the leading maker of AI chips.

meme.top: Nvidia searched far and wide for a CEO
meme.bottom: and found him in the old office
meme.take: Nvidia ran a thorough CEO search and found the candidate had excellent references.

stories.title: GTA VI sold an estimated 44.9 million copies in its first four days
stories.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA VI sold 44.9 million units and grossed over $4 billion by the end of its launch weekend.
stories.why: GTA VI is the most anticipated game in years, and its sales are a benchmark for the whole industry.
stories.happened: The figures are a third-party estimate reported by The Fly; Take-Two has not confirmed them. The game launched on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S at $79.99, with no PC date yet.
stories.next: Watch for Take-Two's own sales figures and any PC release date.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Tens of millions of copies in days is close to unheard of.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The game sells at $79.99, above the usual price.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' best-selling series; GTA V came out in 2013. Rockstar is owned by Take-Two.

meme.top: GTA VI sold 44.9 million copies
meme.bottom: the traffic in Vice City is now real
meme.take: GTA VI sold an estimated 44.9 million copies, and every one of them is stuck in traffic.

stories.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Sol to paid ChatGPT users
stories.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6.2 Sol to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users, promising better instruction-following.
stories.why: ChatGPT is the most used AI chatbot, so a new default model reaches a huge audience at once.
stories.happened: MacRumors reports the rollout to paid plans, with improvements in following instructions and reading small details. Roundups say it reached paid users worldwide on November 24.
stories.next: Watch for independent tests comparing it with the latest models from Anthropic and Google.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: OpenAI's model updates set the pace for the industry.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It lands amid a busy month of releases from rival labs.

stories.background: OpenAI makes ChatGPT and the GPT family of AI models.

meme.top: OpenAI has a new model that listens
meme.bottom: it was told to ship another model
meme.take: OpenAI's new model is better at following instructions, a rare quality this month.

stories.title: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120 million in the US and $225 million worldwide
stories.summary: The Hunger Games prequel opened to an estimated $120 million in North America and $225 million worldwide, AP reports.
stories.why: A strong debut would show book-based franchises can still fill cinemas in a crowded holiday season.
stories.happened: It took $56 million on Friday, including $21 million in previews, and made up about 72% of all weekend ticket sales. Audiences gave it an A- CinemaScore, up from B+ for the last prequel.
stories.next: Watch for how it holds over the Thanksgiving five-day weekend against Hexed and Focker In-Law.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: It beat Lionsgate's own $85 million weekend forecast.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It was about 2.7 times the opening of The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opened the week before Thanksgiving, a strong window for long runs.

stories.background: The Hunger Games films are based on Suzanne Collins' novels. This is the second prequel, following a young Haymitch Abernathy.

meme.top: A film about a deadly televised contest
meme.bottom: is winning its own contest
meme.take: The Hunger Games returns to cinemas, which are once again fighting to survive the weekend.

stories.title: SpaceX and Tesla reportedly name directors to negotiate a $3.5 trillion merger
stories.summary: SpaceX and Tesla have each named directors to negotiate a possible merger valued at $3.5 trillion, the Financial Times reports.
stories.why: Combining two of Elon Musk's biggest companies would create one of the most valuable firms ever.
stories.happened: The FT reports five directors were named to negotiate a potential deal, with a target of closing by the end of the year. Neither company has announced a merger.
stories.next: Watch for any formal announcement or shareholder vote from either company.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: A $3.5 trillion combination would be among the largest deals on record.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Both companies are led by Elon Musk.

stories.background: SpaceX builds rockets and runs Starlink; Tesla makes electric cars and batteries. Both are run by Elon Musk.

meme.top: Two Musk companies may merge
meme.bottom: so the meetings get shorter
meme.take: Two Musk companies may merge, saving everyone the trouble of telling them apart.

stories.title: CIA and US intelligence office reportedly hit by breach of unclassified data
stories.summary: Some unclassified information at the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence was breached, The New York Times reports.
stories.why: A breach at the top US spy agencies, even of unclassified systems, raises questions about government security.
stories.happened: Reuters relayed the New York Times report that the CIA and ODNI had some unclassified information breached. AP, citing a source, said an unclassified CIA system was hit in a cyberattack. Details remain limited.
stories.next: Watch for an official statement on what was taken and who was behind it.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The CIA is among the most security-conscious organisations in the world.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Even unclassified government data can be useful to attackers.

stories.background: The Office of the Director of National Intelligence oversees the US intelligence agencies, including the CIA.

meme.top: The spy agency lost some files
meme.bottom: the unclassified kind, they stress
meme.take: Some unclassified CIA data is now, presumably, even less classified.

stories.title: Amazon agrees to buy Decart's AI optimisation technology and team
stories.summary: Amazon agreed to buy Decart's AI optimisation stack and bring in its team; TechCrunch reports the deal is worth $7.5 billion.
stories.why: Software that makes AI run faster on Amazon's own chips could help it compete with Nvidia.
stories.happened: Amazon's announcement does not give a price and says the deal needs regulatory clearance. TechCrunch reports $7.5 billion and links it to Amazon's plans to sell its Trainium chips.
stories.next: Watch for regulatory review and how Amazon uses the technology with Trainium.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The reported price is $7.5 billion.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Amazon is pushing its own chips as an alternative to Nvidia.

stories.background: Amazon Web Services is the largest cloud provider and designs its own AI chips, called Trainium.

meme.top: Amazon bought software to speed up AI
meme.bottom: checkout was, as ever, one click
meme.take: Amazon spent a reported $7.5 billion to make its own chips feel less lonely.

stories.title: Anthropic posts a Claude-authored paper claiming a major result in complexity theory
stories.summary: Anthropic published a 70-page paper credited to Claude that claims VP is not equal to VNP, with a Lean formalisation; no human has checked it yet.
stories.why: It comes days after the Riemann claim, adding to a debate about AI doing frontier mathematics.
stories.happened: The paper and proof code were pushed to Anthropic's formal-math repository on November 23. Anthropic says no human mathematician has checked it. It explicitly does not settle P vs NP.
stories.next: Watch for whether mathematicians confirm the formal statement and the proof.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: A paper with an AI as its author line is unusual.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows the Riemann Hypothesis claim by days.

stories.background: VP and VNP are algebraic versions of the famous P and NP classes, which ask which problems are easy to compute.

meme.top: Claude wrote a 70-page proof
meme.bottom: now 70 pages need a human
meme.take: Claude wrote the proof and signed it. The peer reviewers have yet to RSVP.

stories.title: SpaceX is reportedly selling computing capacity to Anthropic and Google
stories.summary: SpaceX is selling computing capacity to AI rivals Anthropic and Google, The New York Times reports.
stories.why: Elon Musk's companies compete in AI, so renting compute to rivals shows how scarce AI capacity is.
stories.happened: The New York Times reported the arrangements on November 23. They come as SpaceX expands its AI data-centre plans and as compute demand keeps rising across the industry.
stories.next: Watch for the size of the deals and whether more AI labs sign up.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: SpaceX's own AI unit competes with the labs it is serving.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI labs are buying compute wherever they can find it.

stories.background: SpaceX, best known for rockets and Starlink, now also owns Elon Musk's AI business.

meme.top: SpaceX is renting servers to its rivals
meme.bottom: the competition is also the customer
meme.take: SpaceX competes with Anthropic and Google, and also sends them an invoice.

stories.title: CD Projekt signs a Sony marketing deal for The Witcher 4
stories.summary: CD Projekt has signed a marketing deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, and compares its leap over Witcher 3 to GTA V to GTA VI.
stories.why: Marketing deals shape where big games are shown first, and The Witcher 4 is one of the most awaited RPGs.
stories.happened: Gamingroute reports the Sony deal. CD Projekt compares the jump from The Witcher 3 to the jump from GTA V to GTA VI. No release date has been given.
stories.next: Watch for a release window and what the Sony deal includes for PlayStation players.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The Witcher 3 is one of the best-selling RPGs ever.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Marketing deals are a long-running PlayStation and Xbox battleground.

stories.background: CD Projekt Red is the Polish studio behind The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077.

meme.top: CD Projekt compared itself to GTA VI
meme.bottom: during the week of GTA VI
meme.take: CD Projekt compared its next leap to GTA VI, a brave move during GTA VI's week.

stories.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with all eight episodes on November 25
stories.summary: All eight episodes of Blade Runner 2099, starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, stream on Prime Video from today, November 25.
stories.why: It continues one of science fiction's most influential film series on television.
stories.happened: BillFrost.tv says the series, created by Silka Luisa, had been stuck in development since 2024. TVLine also lists all episodes for November 25.
stories.next: Watch for reviews once all the episodes are out.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Blade Runner (1982) is a cult science fiction classic.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Michelle Yeoh leads the cast.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: All episodes drop just before the holiday weekend.

stories.background: Blade Runner is Ridley Scott's 1982 film based on a Philip K. Dick novel. A sequel, Blade Runner 2049, followed in 2017.

meme.top: A show about spotting the machines
meme.bottom: arrives in the year of AI
meme.take: Blade Runner 2099 lands just as the question it asks has become an everyday chore.

stories.title: US blacklists chip firm Megaspeed, and Malaysia orders data centres to cut it off
stories.summary: The US added Singapore's Megaspeed to its trade blacklist amid claims about Nvidia chip exports to China; Malaysia then ordered data centres to cut it off.
stories.why: It shows how US export controls on AI chips now reach data centres across Southeast Asia.
stories.happened: Reuters reported the blacklisting, citing a source. Bloomberg says Malaysia told data centres to cut off Megaspeed and six other blacklisted firms. The BBC says the company denies wrongdoing.
stories.next: Watch for whether other countries in the region follow Malaysia's lead.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is part of the US effort to keep advanced AI chips out of China.

drivers.label: Ripple effect
drivers.text: Malaysia acted within a day of the US move.

stories.background: The US 'entity list' restricts exports to listed firms, and has been used heavily to limit China's access to AI chips.

meme.top: One blacklist in Washington
meme.bottom: seven unplugged racks in Malaysia
meme.take: Washington updated a list, and data centres in Malaysia started pulling cables.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to help get code changes merged
stories.summary: Anthropic's Claude Ship beta adds PR Steward and Claude Approvals agents to help move pull requests through review on GitHub.
stories.why: Coding is the busiest use of AI agents, and this moves them closer to the final step of shipping code.
stories.happened: PR Steward fixes failing checks, conflicts and review feedback but does not approve or merge. Approvals follow each repository's policy, with an observe-only mode advised first. It runs with a /ship command.
stories.next: Watch for how teams use the approval agent and what limits they set on it.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Coding agents are moving from writing code to shipping it.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Anthropic's Claude is widely used for coding.

stories.background: Anthropic makes the Claude AI models and the Claude Code coding tool.

meme.top: The AI fixes your pull request
meme.bottom: a human still presses merge
meme.take: Claude can now fix your pull request, then wait politely for a human to press merge.

stories.title: GTA VI ties Ocarina of Time with a 99 on Metacritic
stories.summary: GTA VI's reviews give it a Metacritic score of 99, level with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Shattered reports.
stories.why: Ocarina of Time has held the top Metacritic spot for decades, so matching it is a rare feat.
stories.happened: Shattered calls it a tie rather than a record broken. GameRant has also covered the gap between critic and user scores on the PlayStation Store and Metacritic.
stories.next: Watch for whether the score holds as more reviews arrive.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Ocarina of Time has long been the benchmark for review scores.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: GTA VI is the biggest release of the year.

stories.background: Metacritic averages critics' reviews into a score out of 100. Ocarina of Time launched on the Nintendo 64 in 1998.

meme.top: GTA VI matched Ocarina of Time
meme.bottom: it only took 28 years and helicopters
meme.take: GTA VI tied Ocarina of Time, and Ocarina did it without a single helicopter.

stories.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie comes to Netflix on November 30
stories.summary: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie joins Netflix's US library on November 30 after its Peacock run, Collider reports.
stories.why: It was the year's first billion-dollar film, so its streaming debut is a big holiday draw.
stories.happened: Collider says the film was the first 2026 release to pass $1 billion at the box office, short of the $1.3 billion of the 2023 original. A further sequel is said not to be expected before 2029.
stories.next: Watch for whether it tops Netflix's film chart in its first week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Mario is Nintendo's most famous character.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It passed $1 billion at the box office.

stories.background: The Super Mario Bros. Movie from Illumination and Nintendo was one of 2023's biggest hits.

meme.top: A billion-dollar film reaches Netflix
meme.bottom: Mario has seen tougher pipes
meme.take: A billion-dollar Mario film lands on Netflix, the couch finally beating the cinema.

stories.title: Anthropic mathematician says Claude helped him prove the Riemann Hypothesis
stories.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he proved the Riemann Hypothesis with help from Claude, Bloomberg reports.
stories.why: The Riemann Hypothesis is one of the most famous unsolved problems in mathematics, so a proof would be historic.
stories.happened: Levent Alpöge published a computer-checkable proof claim. Independent mathematicians have compiled the Lean code but are still checking whether its formal statement matches the real hypothesis, The Neuron reports.
stories.next: Watch for whether reviewers agree the formal statement captures the actual Riemann Hypothesis, as Anthropic posts more proofs.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: An AI-assisted proof of a problem this famous would be a first.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It is one of the Clay Institute's million-dollar Millennium Prize Problems.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The formal proof is reported at about 17 million lines.

stories.background: Posed by Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the zeros of the zeta function, which are tied to how primes are spread.

meme.top: The proof compiles
meme.bottom: the mathematicians do not, yet
meme.take: The code checks out. Now the humans have to check what the code was actually about.

stories.title: OpenAI and Cisco release Shirudo, an open-source runtime for AI-written security patches
stories.summary: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, which loads temporary kernel protections on running Linux systems while real patches are prepared.
stories.why: It is a test of whether AI can write stopgap defences quickly when a new flaw appears.
stories.happened: In a controlled test, a Codex-written shield blocked a Java4Shell exploit on a running server without a restart. It is pre-release and BSD-licensed, and deploying shields needs security-team approval.
stories.next: Watch for early adopters and whether the shields hold up outside controlled tests.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It lets AI agents write and deploy kernel shields.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrives after a run of serious open-source flaws.

stories.background: eBPF is a Linux feature that lets small programs run safely inside the kernel, often used for security tools.

meme.top: An AI writes a patch for the patch
meme.bottom: until the real patch shows up
meme.take: OpenAI and Cisco built a plaster for Linux that an AI applies while the doctor is on the way.

stories.title: Azure API Management flaw used to steal secrets, Norway links it to energy firm attacks
stories.summary: Attackers abused a flaw in Azure API Management Classic tiers to read stored secrets and keys; Microsoft closed the path on November 19.
stories.why: Stolen cloud keys can open other systems, and the flaw is linked to attacks on energy companies.
stories.happened: Attackers could read named values, client secrets, subscription keys and tokens. Norway's NSM linked the activity to intrusions at Equinor and Skagerak Energi, The Register reports. No CVE was assigned, and stolen secrets must be rotated.
stories.next: Watch for guidance from Microsoft and whether more victims come forward.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The fix does not revoke keys that were already stolen.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Classic tiers from Developer to Premium were affected.

stories.background: Azure API Management is Microsoft's cloud service for publishing and securing companies' APIs.

meme.top: Microsoft fixed the leak
meme.bottom: the keys already left the building
meme.take: Microsoft patched the hole. Everyone now has to change the locks the burglars copied.

stories.title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok sexual deepfake images
stories.summary: Oregon and Virginia sued SpaceX and related companies, alleging Grok generated nonconsensual sexualised images, including of children.
stories.why: It is a major legal test of who is responsible when an AI tool is used to make abusive images.
stories.happened: The states allege inadequate safeguards and misleading safety claims, and seek civil penalties and court orders, CNBC reports. The claims are allegations and have not been proven in court.
stories.next: Watch for the companies' response and whether other states file similar suits.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Abusive AI images are a growing concern for lawmakers.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Grok is the chatbot from Elon Musk's AI business.

stories.background: Grok is an AI chatbot built by xAI, Elon Musk's AI company, which is now part of SpaceX.

meme.top: Two states have taken Grok to court
meme.bottom: over images it allegedly made
meme.take: Two US states say Grok's safeguards did not hold, and they want a court to decide.

stories.title: The Hunt for Gollum reportedly casts Anya Taylor-Joy as an Elf
stories.summary: Anya Taylor-Joy will play an Elf named Seren in The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum, Collider reports.
stories.why: A new Lord of the Rings film is a major event for one of the best-loved fantasy series.
stories.happened: Collider reports the film is expected in cinemas on December 17, 2027, the same day as Avengers: Secret Wars. Jamie Dornan is reported to replace Viggo Mortensen as Aragorn, with Ian McKellen and Elijah Wood returning.
stories.next: Watch for an official cast announcement and whether the release date holds.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: It brings back actors from the original trilogy.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is reported to share a date with Avengers: Secret Wars.

stories.background: The Lord of the Rings films are based on J.R.R. Tolkien's novels; Peter Jackson's trilogy came out in 2001-2003.

meme.top: The Hunt for Gollum adds new Elves
meme.bottom: Gollum remains unavailable
meme.take: The Hunt for Gollum keeps adding cast. Gollum remains hard to find.

stories.title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.4 with a 1 million token context window
stories.summary: China's Z.ai released GLM-5.4, which it calls its first Loop Transformer flagship, with a 1 million token context and image support.
stories.why: Chinese labs keep releasing strong models quickly, adding pressure on US rivals.
stories.happened: Z.ai claims it performs like 2 to 3 trillion parameter models. It is live in Z.ai's chat and coding products; the API is 'coming soon' and open weights are promised after safety work.
stories.next: Watch for the API launch and independent benchmarks of Z.ai's claims.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is part of a fast-moving race among Chinese AI labs.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It offers a 1 million token context window.

stories.background: Z.ai, also known as Zhipu AI, is a Beijing AI company known for its GLM series of language models.

meme.top: Z.ai's model reads a million tokens
meme.bottom: it will remember this meeting
meme.take: Z.ai's new model has a million-token memory and an API that is coming soon.

stories.title: Deborah Ann Woll cast as Faye in Amazon's God of War series
stories.summary: Amazon MGM Studios says Deborah Ann Woll will play Faye, Kratos's late wife, in its live-action God of War series.
stories.why: God of War is one of PlayStation's biggest series, and fans watch every casting choice closely.
stories.happened: Amazon MGM Studios announced the casting on November 23. No release date has been set for the series.
stories.next: Watch for more casting news and a first look at the show.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: God of War fans follow the adaptation closely.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Game adaptations have become big business for streamers.

stories.background: God of War is Sony's action series about Kratos; its Norse-era games began in 2018. Woll is known for Daredevil.

meme.top: Amazon cast a character
meme.bottom: who is mostly famous for being gone
meme.take: Amazon cast a God of War character whose main role in the games was being missed.

stories.title: Netflix's The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth starts a two-week IMAX run
stories.summary: The Netflix film plays in IMAX cinemas from November 25 for two weeks before it premieres on the service on December 23.
stories.why: Netflix rarely puts its films in big-screen cinemas, so a run like this draws attention.
stories.happened: Occupy Cinema lists the IMAX run starting on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving. AP also describes it as a Netflix IMAX release over the holiday corridor.
stories.next: Watch for its IMAX box office over the holiday weekend.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opens on the busiest moviegoing week of autumn.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Netflix theatrical runs in IMAX are unusual.

stories.background: Cliff Booth was Brad Pitt's stuntman character in the 2019 film Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.

meme.top: A Netflix film is in cinemas
meme.bottom: for exactly as long as it takes
meme.take: Netflix gives Cliff Booth two weeks on the big screen, then the usual couch residency.

stories.title: SNL sets Seyfried, De Niro and Chalamet as December hosts
stories.summary: SNL confirmed Amanda Seyfried on December 5, Robert De Niro on December 12 and Timothee Chalamet on December 19.
stories.why: SNL's holiday episodes are among its most watched, and the line-up mixes three very different stars.
stories.happened: Musical guests are Don Toliver, Slayyyter and Charli xcx. Consequence notes that De Niro, at 83, would be the second-oldest host after Betty White, who hosted at 88.
stories.next: Watch for the sketches that come out of the Christmas episode.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: All three hosts are major film stars.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The run ends with the Christmas episode.

stories.background: Saturday Night Live is NBC's long-running live sketch comedy show, first broadcast in 1975.

meme.top: Robert De Niro is hosting SNL at 83
meme.bottom: the cue cards will be large
meme.take: SNL booked De Niro for December, and the cast will be on their best behaviour.

stories.title: Disney's animated Hexed leads the Thanksgiving week cinema openings
stories.summary: Disney's Hexed opens wide on November 25, alongside Hershey, Bitter Christmas and A24's Club Kid, with Focker In-Law following on November 27.
stories.why: Thanksgiving is one of the biggest moviegoing weeks of the year, and family films usually lead it.
stories.happened: Occupy Cinema, citing Box Office Mojo's calendar, lists Hexed from Disney, Hershey from Angel Studios and Bitter Christmas from Sony Pictures Classics for Wednesday. AP lists Universal's Focker In-Law for Friday.
stories.next: Watch for the five-day holiday totals and how Hexed fares against the Hunger Games prequel.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Thanksgiving week is a traditional window for family films.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: New openers face the Hunger Games prequel in its second week.

stories.background: Disney animation has often released films over Thanksgiving, including Frozen in 2013.

meme.top: Disney opens a film called Hexed
meme.bottom: on a week of family gatherings
meme.take: Hexed arrives on Thanksgiving, a holiday with plenty of family curses already.

stories.title: Broadcom patches another critical vCenter flaw after a recent zero-day
stories.summary: Broadcom fixed 23 VMware flaws, including a 9.8-rated authentication bypass in vCenter's directory service, CVE-2026-123903.
stories.why: vCenter runs many companies' virtual servers, and it was hit by an exploited zero-day only weeks ago.
stories.happened: The fix covers ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion and Avi Load Balancer. Broadcom says none of the new flaws are known to be exploited, and that this bug is separate from the zero-day linked to a suspected China-nexus group.
stories.next: Watch for whether attackers begin targeting the new flaw before systems are patched.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: An authentication bypass can let attackers skip the login entirely.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows closely after an exploited vCenter zero-day.

stories.background: Broadcom bought VMware, whose vCenter software manages virtual machines in many corporate data centres.

meme.top: vCenter got a new lock
meme.bottom: to replace the last new lock
meme.take: vCenter admins are patching again, which by now counts as a hobby.

stories.title: Meta launches its Muse AI agent in the UK
stories.summary: Meta's personal AI agent, Muse, is now available to UK adults on mobile, web and WhatsApp, and can keep working after the app closes.
stories.why: Meta can put an agent in front of billions of users through WhatsApp and its other apps.
stories.happened: Meta says users must approve actions such as sending email or making purchases. Access is free, with optional subscriptions for higher usage. Muse is also available as a Chrome sidebar extension.
stories.next: Watch for how many UK users try it and when it reaches other countries.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: WhatsApp gives Meta a huge built-in audience.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Big tech firms are racing to launch personal agents.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, and builds the Llama family of AI models.

meme.top: Meta's agent asks before buying things
meme.bottom: which is more than most of us do
meme.take: Meta's agent asks before it spends your money, a level of restraint few apps share.

stories.title: Switch 2 Mario Kart World bundle drops to $499 for Black Friday
stories.summary: Amazon and Walmart are selling the Switch 2 with Mario Kart World for $499, $50 below its $549 price, for a limited time.
stories.why: It is one of the first real price cuts on Nintendo's new console in its first holiday season.
stories.happened: Amazon and Walmart are selling the bundle for $499, which Nintendo Wire calls one of the biggest Switch 2 deals yet. In the UK, Shattered lists the Switch 2 at £399 for Black Friday.
stories.next: Watch for whether stock lasts through Black Friday weekend.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It is $50 off the bundle's usual price.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Black Friday is the biggest console sales week.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Mario Kart is among Nintendo's best-selling series.

stories.background: The Switch 2 is Nintendo's latest console, the follow-up to the 2017 Switch.

meme.top: Fifty dollars off a Switch 2
meme.bottom: the shells are still full price
meme.take: Black Friday takes $50 off Mario Kart, which will be lost to a blue shell by Saturday.

stories.title: Cisco Expressway flaw exploited to break into internal networks
stories.summary: Attackers used a critical Cisco Expressway flaw, CVE-2026-76466, to get root access on devices and move into internal networks, Help Net Security reports.
stories.why: Expressway handles video calls at the edge of many company networks, so a flaw there opens the door inside.
stories.happened: Security firm F6 says attackers took over two internet-facing devices, then reached two internal cluster nodes. CISA added the flaw to its exploited list on November 20. Cisco's fix is version X15.5.20.
stories.next: Watch for further victims and how quickly organisations apply the patch.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: It gives an unauthenticated attacker root access.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Expressway is used widely for business video calls.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: CISA has told US agencies to patch.

stories.background: CISA, the US cybersecurity agency, keeps a list of flaws known to be exploited and sets patch deadlines for agencies.

meme.top: A device built to keep calls secure
meme.bottom: let the callers in
meme.take: Cisco's video gateway was a little too welcoming to uninvited guests.

stories.title: Amazon delivery drone crashes into a Michigan garage, and the FAA is investigating
stories.summary: An Amazon delivery drone crashed into a garage in Michigan, and the Federal Aviation Administration is investigating, CNBC reports.
stories.why: Drone delivery depends on public trust that the aircraft will stay out of homes.
stories.happened: CNBC reports the drone came down on a garage in Michigan. The FAA has opened an investigation into the crash.
stories.next: Watch for the FAA's findings and any change to Amazon's drone flights in the area.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Crashes test regulators' patience with delivery drones.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Amazon has spent years building its Prime Air drone service.

stories.background: Amazon's Prime Air service uses drones to deliver small parcels in selected US areas.

meme.top: Amazon's drone made it to the house
meme.bottom: just not the front door
meme.take: Amazon's drone found the garage before it found the porch.

stories.title: Nioh 3 is coming to Xbox Series X|S on January 28
stories.summary: Nioh 3 and its Complete Edition launch on Xbox Series X|S on January 28, 2027, with the Bloody Insurrection DLC on December 17.
stories.why: Nioh is a popular hardcore action series that had been tied to PlayStation.
stories.happened: Gamingroute reports the Xbox date. The Bloody Insurrection DLC arrives first, on December 17. Price and Game Pass status have not been stated.
stories.next: Watch for the Xbox price and whether it joins Game Pass.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Xbox players have long asked for the series.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: More former PlayStation games are coming to Xbox.

stories.background: Nioh is a Team Ninja series of difficult samurai action games, published by Koei Tecmo.

meme.top: Nioh 3 is coming to Xbox
meme.bottom: new players can now be humbled too
meme.take: Nioh 3 comes to Xbox, giving a whole new console audience the chance to lose.

stories.title: DeepMind agents find faster quantum algorithms for fusion research
stories.summary: Google DeepMind says its AI agents improved quantum algorithms for fusion research, cutting estimated computing costs by 11.8 times.
stories.why: It is another example of AI agents being used to make real scientific progress.
stories.happened: The agents shared ideas in virtual meetings every four hours, and a formal proof system checked their solutions, DeepMind says.
stories.next: Watch for whether the improved algorithms are tested on real quantum hardware.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The estimated cost cut is 11.8 times.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Labs are pairing AI agents with formal verification.

stories.background: Google DeepMind is Google's main AI research lab, known for AlphaGo and AlphaFold.

meme.top: AI agents met every four hours
meme.bottom: and still got work done
meme.take: DeepMind's agents met every four hours and still produced results, a first for meetings.

stories.title: Stevie Wonder jokes about blindness rumours at his Chicago show
stories.summary: At a November 21 concert in Chicago, Stevie Wonder answered the online theory that he is not really blind by inviting fans to get in the car with him.
stories.why: A long-running internet rumour met a direct answer from the man himself, and the clip spread.
stories.happened: The show at the United Center was part of his 50th-anniversary Songs in the Key of Life tour, Consequence reports.
stories.next: Watch for the remaining dates of the anniversary tour.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Stevie Wonder is one of the best-selling musicians of all time.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The tour marks 50 years of Songs in the Key of Life.

stories.background: Songs in the Key of Life, released in 1976, is Stevie Wonder's double album and is widely ranked among the greatest albums.

meme.top: The internet had a theory
meme.bottom: Stevie Wonder offered it a lift
meme.take: Stevie Wonder settled an internet theory with one offer of a ride.

stats.label: years of Songs in the Key of Life

stories.title: GTA VI's first big patch, 1.002.002, comes with seven official fixes
stories.summary: Rockstar's update 1.002.002 is live on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and reports now list seven official fixes after it launched with no notes.
stories.why: Millions of new players want to know what a first patch fixes in a game this big.
stories.happened: The update is about 600MB on PS5 and around 1.6GB on Xbox. Pure Xbox reports seven official fixes. Players have also found a Quick Resume bug that unlocks a higher frame rate on Xbox, with drawbacks.
stories.next: Watch for Rockstar's next patch and whether it addresses Xbox performance.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: GTA VI is the biggest launch of the year.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players are tracking every change after release.

stories.background: Rockstar often releases console patches without detailed public notes.

meme.top: Rockstar released a patch with no notes
meme.bottom: the notes arrived later, seven of them
meme.take: GTA VI's first patch shipped first and explained itself later, like its characters.

stories.title: HPE's quarterly revenue rises 50% to $14.5 billion
stories.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise reported fourth-quarter revenue of $14.5 billion, up 50% from a year earlier, with net income of $1.8 billion.
stories.why: HPE's results are read as a sign of how much companies are spending on servers and data centres.
stories.happened: The results cover HPE's fiscal fourth quarter of 2026. HPE also reported $5.8 billion in cash. CrowdStrike, Zoom and Zscaler posted results the same day.
stories.next: Watch for HPE's outlook for the year ahead and how investors react.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Revenue grew by half in one year.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Several big tech firms reported results on the same day.

stories.background: Hewlett Packard Enterprise sells servers, storage and networking gear to businesses; it split from HP in 2015.

meme.top: HPE grew revenue by half
meme.bottom: its servers are not resting
meme.take: HPE grew revenue 50% in a year, and the servers are not asking for a day off.

stories.title: Peter Berg's football drama The Mosquito Bowl premieres on Netflix
stories.summary: The Mosquito Bowl, a football drama set after Pearl Harbor, premieres on Netflix on November 25.
stories.why: A sports film arriving the day before Thanksgiving football fits the holiday viewing mood.
stories.happened: TVLine lists Nicholas Galitzine, Bill Skarsgard, Ray Nicholson and Tom Francis in the cast. BillFrost.tv says Peter Berg directs.
stories.next: Watch for whether it reaches Netflix's top ten over the holiday weekend.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands just before Thanksgiving football.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Peter Berg directed Friday Night Lights.

stories.background: Peter Berg is a director known for Friday Night Lights and Lone Survivor.

meme.top: A football film about wartime
meme.bottom: released the day before the big games
meme.take: Netflix found the one thing to watch on Thanksgiving that is also football.

stories.title: Optimizely supply-chain attack put a card skimmer on 178 brands' sites
stories.summary: Malicious code in Optimizely's JavaScript ran on 178 brands' websites on November 16, skimming card data and swapping crypto addresses, reports say.
stories.why: One compromised supplier script can reach shoppers on many big sites at once, days before Black Friday.
stories.happened: Report URI counts at least 178 affected organisations, including CNN, BBC and IKEA. The code skimmed card data and swapped crypto addresses. Optimizely confirms a flaw was exploited and says it is fixed.
stories.next: Watch for the list of affected brands and notices to shoppers.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: 178 brands were affected.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It hit just before the biggest online shopping week.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Attackers target shared scripts to reach many sites.

stories.background: Optimizely makes tools that let websites test different page designs, using scripts loaded on customers' sites.

meme.top: Optimizely helps sites test changes
meme.bottom: someone tested a very bad one
meme.take: Optimizely's script ran an experiment on 178 brands. The control group was your card.

stories.title: CAD images suggest the iPhone 18e will get an unusual new camera design
stories.summary: Leaked CAD images point to an unusual new camera design for Apple's next budget phone, the iPhone 18e, 9to5Mac reports.
stories.why: The 'e' model is Apple's cheaper iPhone, so its design hints at what many buyers will carry.
stories.happened: 9to5Mac says the CAD images show a camera layout unlike current models. Apple has not announced the phone, and leaked designs can change.
stories.next: Watch for more leaks or cases that confirm the layout.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: iPhone design leaks draw heavy attention every year.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Apple has been changing camera layouts across its range.

stories.background: Apple's 'e' iPhones are lower-priced models that sit below the main iPhone line.

meme.top: Apple redesigned the camera bump
meme.bottom: the case makers have started sweating
meme.take: The cheaper iPhone gets a new camera layout, and the case industry gets a new year.

stories.title: PS Plus adds four more games, including Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza
stories.summary: PS Plus Extra and Premium added Cricket 26, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii, MotoGP 26 and Trepang2 on November 24.
stories.why: Subscriptions are now a main way people try new games, so each monthly drop matters to players.
stories.happened: GameRant puts the four games' combined retail value at $209.96. They follow earlier November additions including Death Stranding 2 and Atomfall. Sony is expected to reveal December's Essential games on November 25.
stories.next: Watch for Sony's December PS Plus Essential announcement.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The four games are worth about $210 at retail.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: PS Plus competes directly with Xbox Game Pass.

stories.background: PlayStation Plus is Sony's subscription service; its Extra and Premium tiers include a rotating game library.

meme.top: PS Plus added $210 of games
meme.bottom: your backlog filed a complaint
meme.take: PS Plus added $210 of games to a backlog that was already worth more than the console.

stories.title: The Hunting Wives season 2 arrives on Netflix on Thanksgiving Day
stories.summary: All eight episodes of The Hunting Wives season 2, with Brittany Snow and Malin Akerman, stream on Netflix on November 26.
stories.why: Its first season became a streaming talking point, so a holiday binge release is a big draw.
stories.happened: BillFrost.tv and TVLine both list all eight episodes for Thanksgiving. BillFrost.tv notes the first season was originally made for Starz.
stories.next: Watch for whether it tops Netflix's TV chart over the weekend.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Holiday binge releases tend to draw big audiences.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The first season built a loyal following.

stories.background: The Hunting Wives is a drama thriller based on a novel by May Cobb.

meme.top: A drama about secrets and family
meme.bottom: released on Thanksgiving
meme.take: Netflix scheduled a show about tense social gatherings for the year's tensest dinner.

stories.title: Valve sets 2027 Steam Fest dates, from desktop companions to rhythm games
stories.summary: Valve's 2027 Steam Fest calendar starts with a Desktop Companion Fest on January 14-18 and includes Couch Co-Op and Rhythm events.
stories.why: Steam's themed festivals drive discounts and attention for smaller games on PC's biggest store.
stories.happened: Gamingroute lists Shop Keeper Fest on January 25 to February 1, a Sheep Fest on February 4-8, Couch Co-Op on February 8-15 and Rhythm on March 8-15. The Spring Sale is reported for March 18-25.
stories.next: Watch for Valve's full 2027 sale calendar and the Winter Sale.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It gives developers and shoppers dates to plan around.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Steam sales are a fixture for PC players.

stories.background: Steam is Valve's PC game store and the largest digital store for PC games.

meme.top: Steam is holding a Sheep Fest
meme.bottom: the sheep have not been consulted
meme.take: Valve's 2027 calendar includes a Sheep Fest, and nobody at Valve seems worried.

stories.title: Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior, with Arkheron on day one
stories.summary: Xbox Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 on November 24, and Arkheron launches in Game Preview on November 27.
stories.why: Game Pass additions decide what millions of subscribers try over the holiday.
stories.happened: PlayStationInfo says Arkheron is a three-player team game where found gear, not a fixed class, sets how you play. Eight games leave the service on November 30.
stories.next: Watch for Microsoft's December Game Pass line-up.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: New games land over Thanksgiving weekend.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Day-one launches on Game Pass are a key Xbox selling point.

stories.background: Xbox Game Pass is Microsoft's subscription that gives access to a rotating library of games.

meme.top: Eight games are leaving Game Pass
meme.bottom: your backlog remains
meme.take: Game Pass adds three games and removes eight, which is still more than most of us finish.

stories.title: Mastodon announce a spring 2027 UK and European tour
stories.summary: Mastodon's Poisonous Weapons Tour heads to the UK and Europe from March 14 in Paris, with Monolord supporting.
stories.why: Mastodon are one of metal's biggest live acts, and fans across Europe now have dates to plan for.
stories.happened: The tour runs through cities including Madrid, London, Budapest and Stockholm. Green Lung join for the UK dates, Consequence reports.
stories.next: Watch for ticket sales and any added dates.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: European fans get a full run of dates.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It was announced months ahead of spring.

stories.background: Mastodon are a heavy metal band from Atlanta, known for albums such as Leviathan and Crack the Skye.

meme.top: Mastodon are touring Europe
meme.bottom: the ears of Europe have been warned
meme.take: Mastodon have announced a European tour, and the venues have been advised to bolt things down.
